title: Understanding Mini-Batch Gradient Descent
text: In mini-batch gradient descent, the dataset is divided into smaller batches. Each batch is used to calculate the gradient once per epoch. Think about how many times the entire dataset is processed in $$5$$ epochs.

title: Calculating Total Gradients
text: If $$125$$ gradients were calculated over $$5$$ epochs, how many gradients were calculated per epoch? This will help you determine the size of each mini-batch.

title: Determine Gradients Per Epoch
text: How many gradients are calculated per epoch if $$125$$ gradients are calculated over $$5$$ epochs?

title: Linking Gradients to Mini-Batch Size
text: Once you know the number of gradients per epoch, consider how this relates to the number of mini-batches. Each gradient corresponds to one mini-batch.

title: Calculate Mini-Batch Size
